This page is drawn from crates/vike-ui-theme/ui-theme.toml, the one file that holds every design value of the desktop GUI. It is regenerated by a test, so it cannot disagree with the app. The switches above change the theme, the text size and the density of the whole page the way the Appearance settings change the app.

Status colours

The same in every theme. A theme recolours the background, the neutrals and the accent, and never recolours "connected".

ok #3fbf6e

A healthy state — a live link, a configured credential, a saved write.

warning #e6b428

Not settled yet — a link dialling or reconnecting, an armed remote-control segment, an account named but not yet saved, a store nobody could open.

error #f0524a

A fault — a failed link, a refused write, an inline error.

info #57a5ff

Information — egui's hyperlink colour.

muted #787878

Nothing live to show — Disconnected and Unknown alike (only a label tells them apart), an unset credential. Grey 120 is a MARK's colour and sits below the 4.5:1 floor for text.

Rules of use

A value says what; a rule says where.

  • Words are Inter. A venue name, an account NAME (main), a label, a button, a menu item.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • Anything read character by character is JetBrains Mono: prices, sizes, counts, addresses, account NUMBERS (3709890).Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • Menu items, buttons and tabs are the Strong role at regular weight (400). Semibold (600) is ruled only where the design draws it — the places listed under weight_use below — and is never a venue or a label.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller, crates/vike-ops/tests/ui_literal_ratchet.rs::no_file_gains_a_heavy_weight
  • Two things on one line (a venue and its account) are told apart by size and ink — the primary ink for the first, the dim ink and the Body size for the second — not by weight.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/account_menu.rs::the_venue_is_regular_and_the_account_is_dim_and_smaller
  • The accent is a shape (an underline, a fill, a ring, an edge), never the colour of a number or a word.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/input.rs::selected_text_is_never_drawn_in_the_accent
  • The status colours are the same in every theme. "Connected" is the status green, never the accent.Enforced by crates/vike-ui-theme/src/components/mod.rs::status_colours_are_fixed_and_never_the_accent, crates/vike-ui-theme/src/status.rs::no_status_colour_is_a_theme_or_market_colour
  • Every window has the same 25 pt title bar at every density. Density scales the controls inside a window, never the bar around it.Words only — no test fails if this is broken.
  • A size is a ROLE. A literal font size anywhere in a GUI crate fails a gate: the Text size setting must reach every window.Enforced by crates/vike-ops/tests/ui_literal_ratchet.rs::no_file_gains_a_literal_text_size

Spacing, strokes and strengths

The steps the kit and the windows draw with. A gap, a line or a mix is a name, not a number typed at the call site.

Spacing

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
XS2pxThe finest step: the padding an icon button leaves round its glyph, and how far the focus ring stands off its widget.
SM4pxA small gap and the vertical padding of a button; the most-used step.
MD6pxA medium gap; Normal density's gap between controls.
LG8pxA large gap; Normal density's cell padding.
XL12pxThe largest step the windows already use.

Strokes

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
HAIRLINE1pxA control's edge, a card's border, a rule: every kit widget draws its outline at this width.
LINE1.5pxA mark that must read at a glance, such as the venue chip's ring.
EDGE2pxThe selected edge: the underline of the chosen tab.

Strengths

TokenValueDrawnWhat it is
LIFT0.12How far a filled button moves toward the text colour while it is hovered or pressed.
WASH0.14How far a chip's fill is mixed into the ground behind it (Mode::wash): enough to read as a coloured band on every theme's near-black background, and little enough that what is written on it still reads. On LIVE's accent wash the least of the three inks is the accent itself as text on Dusk, 5.58:1; the theme text clears 12.21:1 and the warning amber 7.53:1 on every theme, Carbon's amber wash included (8.25:1).

TokenPointsWhat it is
TITLE_BAR_H25The bar's height.
TITLE_INSET9The window's name, or the first thing on the bar, from its left edge.
WINDOW_CONTROL20One window control (─ □ ✕): a square, so its hover fill reads as a button.
WINDOW_CONTROL_GAP4The gap between two controls.
WINDOW_CONTROLS_PAD4The pad after the last control.
SEPARATOR_H14The hairline that parts a tabbed window's segments from the controls: its height.
SLOT_TO_CONTROLS15Between the last segment and the first control: seven points, the hairline, seven more.
SLOT_TO_SEPARATOR7Where the hairline sits, from the last segment.

The mark

The Vike mark and its orange are drawn from crates/vike-ui-theme/src/brand.rs; the files are in this folder (see SOURCES.md). The orange is the logo's colour and never a UI accent.

orange #ff6a00

The brand orange, vike.io's --color-brand. The site's PNG is painted #FF751F; that one is not used (refinement 2).

orange-on-light #d95400

The orange on a LIGHT background: ORANGE on white is under the 3:1 a graphic needs (refinement 4).

Generated — do not edit. Change ui-theme.toml, run VIKE_REGEN_BRAND_ASSETS=1 cargo test -p vike-ui-theme --test brand_assets, and look at this page.
